description: This bar chart illustrates the difference in average Word Error Rate (WER) from Whisper large for different models, specifically NESAC ft model and SESHA ft model. The vertical axis displays the model names – Americanisms, Dates, Normalised, Add Spacing, and Remove Spacing – listed in that order, with no apparent sorting. The horizontal axis, labeled “Difference in Average WER from Whisper large”, represents the WER difference, with a linear scale ranging from 0.000 to 0.0035, with tick labels at intervals of 0.001.  For each model name, there are two adjacent bars: an orange bar representing the NESAC ft model and a green bar representing the SESHA ft model. The orange bars range in length from approximately 0.00228 for “Dates” to 0.00299 for “Americanisms”, while the green bars range from approximately 0.00306 for “Remove Spacing” to 0.00334 for “Normalised”.  Each bar is a solid color with no visual emphasis such as shading or outlining. The values for each bar are directly labeled to the right of the bars.
